content.title: Middleby’s (NASDAQ:MIDD) Q3 Sales Top Estimates
content.summary: Kitchen product manufacturer Middleby (NYSE:MIDD) reported revenue ahead of Wall Streets expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales up 4.2% year on year to $982.1 million. The company expects next quarter’s revenue to be around $1.01 billion, close to analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $2.37 per share was 14.5% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
